sentences.en: Today, why President Biden went back on his work to pardon his own son and where that decision leaves the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，为什么拜登总统违背了自己的承诺，赦免了自己的儿子，以及这一决定将美国司法系统置于何地。

sentences.en: system of justice.
sentences.zh: 司法系统。

sentences.en: Chief White House Correspondent Peter Baker is our gueSt.
sentences.zh: 白宫首席记者彼得·贝克是我们的嘉宾。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月3日，星期二。

sentences.en: Peter, we are reaching you in, of all places, Angola, where you are traveling with President Biden.
sentences.zh: 彼得，我们联系到你时，你竟然身处安哥拉，正在随拜登总统出访。

sentences.en: It's pretty late there for you.
sentences.zh: 那里对你来说时间很晚了吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实。

sentences.en: Yes, Air Force One just landed here in Luanda, the capital, and he got off the plane for the start of a couple-day visit here.
sentences.zh: 没错，空军一号刚刚降落在首都罗安达，他已经走下飞机，开始为期几天的访问。

sentences.en: Didn't talk with the reporters on the plane or those on the ground about anything going on back home, but obviously that's top of mind for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 他没有和机上的记者或地面上的记者谈论国内发生的任何事情，但显然这对很多人来说是心头大事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It seems impossible to imagine that the subject of what he did before he left for Angola is not very much chasing him there.
sentences.zh: 很难想象，他在离开安哥拉之前所做的事情，不会在那里对他造成困扰。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实。

sentences.en: I think it's one of these foreign trips that will be shattered now by a domestic issue that he dealt with literally just hours before getting on the plane,
sentences.zh: 我认为这是那种会被国内问题所破坏的国事访问之一，而这个问题在他登机前几个小时才刚刚处理过，

sentences.en: his decision to pardon his son, Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 那就是他决定赦免他的儿子亨特·拜登。

sentences.en: Well, Peter, I wonder if you can describe your reaction to that announcement because I think for a lot of us, for me at least, it was a real double-take moment.
sentences.zh: 彼得，我想请你描述一下你对这一声明的反应，因为我想对于我们很多人，至少对我来说，这确实让人感到难以置信。

sentences.en: Like, I'm sorry, what?
sentences.zh: 就像是，抱歉，你说什么？

sentences.en: What just happened?
sentences.zh: 刚才发生了什么？

sentences.en: And I wonder what your reaction was as a close student of Joe Biden's for decades, as Chief White House reporter,
sentences.zh: 作为乔·拜登几十年的深入研究者、白宫首席记者，以及一位对总统职位有历史性思考的观察者，我想知道你的反应是什么。

sentences.en: and as a really historically-minded kind of thinker about the presidency.
sentences.zh: 以及作为一名真正具有历史眼光的总统职位思考者。

sentences.en: Well, it's a big deal for a president to use his power of clemency to protect his own son from the justice system, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，总统利用赦免权来保护自己的儿子免受司法系统的制裁，这可是件大事，对吧？

sentences.en: This is something that hasn't happened before.
sentences.zh: 这是以前从未发生过的事情。

sentences.en: There have been a couple of occasions where presidents used the power of the pardon or commutation to help people who are close to them, even members of the family.
sentences.zh: 过去曾有几次总统利用赦免或减刑权来帮助与他们亲近的人，甚至是家庭成员。

sentences.en: Bill Clinton pardoned his brother Roger, who had had old drug charges, and President Donald Trump pardoned Jared Kushner's father from old tax evasion charges.
sentences.zh: 比尔·克林顿赦免了他的兄弟罗杰，他曾有旧的毒品指控；唐纳德·特朗普总统赦免了贾里德·库什纳的父亲，涉及旧的逃税指控。

sentences.en: But this is the first time we've seen a president use the power for his own son and to head off any punishment for that member of the family.
sentences.zh: 但这是我们第一次看到总统利用这一权力为自己的儿子开脱，并阻止对该家庭成员的任何惩罚。

sentences.en: It was both the previous examples came after their sentences had been served and were basically meant as statements of forgiveness, not preventing accountability.
sentences.zh: 之前的两个例子都是在服刑期满后进行的，基本上是作为宽恕的声明，而不是为了阻止问责。

sentences.en: In this case, President Biden is actually interceding before his son is even sentenced, saying, no way, I'm letting him go to prison.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，拜登总统实际上是在他儿子甚至还没被判刑之前就进行干预，说，不行，我不会让他坐牢。

sentences.en: And so in that moment, with the stroke of a pen, he has done something extraordinary by upending the judicial system
sentences.zh: 所以在那一刻，他大笔一挥，做了一件非同寻常的事情，颠覆了他职业生涯，特别是过去四年里一直捍卫的司法系统。

sentences.en: that he has spent his career and particularly the last four years defending.
sentences.zh: 而对他儿子的赦免现在给了共和党人，包括特朗普，攻击的弹药，让他们说司法系统根本不起作用。

sentences.en: And the pardon of his son now gives ammunition to Republicans, including Trump, to say that the justice system doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 它是政治化的。

sentences.en: It is politicized.
sentences.zh: 为什么他们会这么说？

sentences.en: Why did they say that?
sentences.zh: 因为现在乔·拜登自己也这么说了。

sentences.en: Because now Joe Biden has said that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对乔·拜登的政治遗产来说是一个非常、非常重大的时刻。

sentences.en: And I think that's a big, big moment for Joe Biden's legacy.
sentences.zh: 彼得，我们稍后会回到这一切的影响、它的意义，以及它将如何融入拜登的政治遗产中。

sentences.en: We're going to return, Peter, to the implications of all of this, the meaning of it, and how it's going to fit into Biden's legacy.
sentences.zh: 但我想我们能否先从拜登是如何走到这一步的开始谈起。

sentences.en: But I wonder if we can start with how Biden got to this place.
sentences.zh: 因为完全且无条件地赦免他的儿子亨特，是拜登反复说过他永远、永远不会做的事情。

sentences.en: Because pardoning his son, Hunter, fully and unconditionally is something that Biden said repeatedly that he would never, ever do.
sentences.zh: 我想和你谈谈他为什么说他永远不会这样做，以及你对拜登最终改变主意的原因有何了解。

sentences.en: And I want to talk with you about why he said he would never do it and what you've come to understand about why Biden ultimately changed his mind.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，拜登当然是在2020年大选后竞选并就职的，他当时指责特朗普总统将司法部政治化，

sentences.en: Well, Biden, of course, campaigns for office and comes to office after the 2020 election by accusing President Trump of politicizing the Justice Department,
sentences.zh: 将执法决定置于其政治意志之下，打击政敌并偏袒朋友。

sentences.en: of making decisions about law enforcement subject to his political will, going after his enemies and favoring his friends.
sentences.zh: 他说他不会那样做。

sentences.en: And he said he wasn't going to do that.
sentences.zh: 他要恢复司法系统。

sentences.en: He was going to restore the system of justice.
sentences.zh: 但当他上任时，他明白自己的儿子已经在特拉华州被一名联邦检察官调查，涉及多个潜在问题。

sentences.en: But when he comes to office, he understands that his own son is already being investigated by a U.S.
sentences.zh: 而那名联邦检察官被任命为特别检察官，旨在将该起诉与政治隔绝开来。

sentences.en: attorney in Delaware on a number of possible issues.
sentences.zh: 拜登从一开始就做出了决定。

sentences.en: And that U.S.
sentences.zh: 他要保留那位特别检察官，或者至少不会采取任何行动阻止特别检察官继续工作。

sentences.en: attorney has been made into a special counsel, which is meant to insulate that prosecution from politics.
sentences.zh: 然后梅里克·加兰作为司法部长，决定保留同一位特别检察官，以证明他们并没有试图以任何方式影响此案，

sentences.en: And Biden makes a decision from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 特别检察官应该有权按照自己的选择去追求事实。

sentences.en: He's going to keep that special counsel, or at least not going to do anything to stop that special counsel from continuing.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登采取的是不干预的态度。

sentences.en: And then Merrick Garland, as attorney general, makes the decision to keep that same special counsel in place to demonstrate that they're not trying to influence this in any way,
sentences.zh: 这就是他所说的。

sentences.en: that the special prosecutor should have the right to pursue the facts as he chooses.
sentences.zh: 他要采取不干预的态度。

sentences.en: So Biden was taking a hands-off approach.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's what he said.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，他确实是在这段时期言行一致，因为他在向世界表明，你知道，

sentences.en: He was going to take a hands-off approach.
sentences.zh: 你当然可以理解为什么我可能想代表我的儿子进行干预，但我原则上拒绝这样做。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in that sense, he's really putting his money where his mouth was during this period because he's saying to the world, you know,
sentences.zh: 他将其作为一个原则问题。

sentences.en: you certainly could understand why I might want to intercede on behalf of my son, but I refuse on principle.
sentences.zh: 他将其作为与他的前任、现在的继任者唐纳德·特朗普形成对比的一个点。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他利用这一点来证明司法部在追究特朗普时是中立的，做出的决定是不受政治影响的。

sentences.en: He makes it a point of principle.
sentences.zh: 因为他的观点是，嘿，起诉特朗普的司法部也在起诉我的儿子，而我与这两件事都毫无关系。

sentences.en: He makes it a point of contrast with his predecessor and now successor, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 这完全是基于事实和法律。

sentences.en: And he uses this, in fact, to make the case that the Justice Department is, in fact, neutral and making politics-free decisions when they go after Trump.
sentences.zh: 这就是他当时提出的论点。

sentences.en: Because his point is, hey, the Justice Department that is prosecuting Trump is also prosecuting my son, and I'm not having anything to do with either one of those things.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is just based on facts and law.
sentences.zh: 因为对其中一项调查表示怀疑，就可能对所有调查表示怀疑，这就是为什么他要保留判断，远离所有这些事情。

sentences.en: That was the argument he was making.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because to cast doubt on one of those investigations was to potentially cast doubt on all of them, which is why he's going to withhold judgment, steer clear of all this stuff.
sentences.zh: 但与这一切并行的是另一条轨道，即众议院共和党人的党派调查，

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 他们针对亨特提出了各种有时未经证实的理论，关于他可能利用父亲的影响力赚钱的各种方式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以你有这两条轨道在进行。

sentences.en: But parallel to all this, of course, is a separate track, which is a partisan investigation by the House Republicans,
sentences.zh: 一条是专业检察官，他们最终以枪支指控和税务指控起诉了亨特·拜登。

sentences.en: who are going after Hunter on all kinds of sometimes unproven theories about all the different ways he might have abused his father's influence to make money.
sentences.zh: 另一条是平行的众议院共和党调查，白宫当然将其视为仅仅是为了损害总统的努力。

sentences.en: And so you have these two tracks going on.
sentences.zh: 但最终正式的法律程序加强了，亨特·拜登被起诉并接受审判。

sentences.en: One, the professional prosecutors, who end up charging Hunter Biden with gun charges and tax charges.
sentences.zh: 他被陪审团裁定在枪支申请表上撒谎有罪。

sentences.en: And then the parallel House Republican investigation, which is seen certainly in the White House as just an effort to damage the president.
sentences.zh: 然后在另一次审判中，他就逃税罪认罪。

sentences.en: But eventually the official legal proceedings intensify and Hunter Biden is charged and brought to trial.
sentences.zh: 这些都是真实的指控，不是由国会议员提出的，而是由专业检察官提出的，有法官，在一种情况下，还有一个做出裁决的陪审团。

sentences.en: And he's found guilty by a jury of his peers of lying on a firearms application form.
sentences.zh: 因此，亨特面临的刑期在一种情况下可能长达25年。

sentences.en: And then in a separate trial, he pleads guilty to tax evasion.
sentences.zh: 尽管作为初犯，他可能会预期刑期较短，甚至可能只是缓刑。

sentences.en: And these are real charges not brought by members of Congress, but by professional prosecutors with judges and in one case, a jury that makes a finding.
sentences.zh: 当我们坐在诺曼底时，你的儿子亨特正在受审。

sentences.en: And so Hunter faces a sentence that could last up to 25 years in one case.
sentences.zh: 我知道你不能谈论……

sentences.en: Though as a first-time offender, he would likely expect a shorter sentence, possibly even just parole.
sentences.zh: 我们记者正在问拜登总统那个显而易见的问题。

sentences.en: As we sit here in Normandy, your son Hunter is on trial.
sentences.zh: 无论结果如何，你会接受陪审团的结果、他们的裁决吗？

sentences.en: And I know that you cannot speak about...
sentences.zh: 会。

sentences.en: We reporters are asking President Biden the obvious question.
sentences.zh: 你排除了赦免你儿子的可能性吗？

sentences.en: Will you accept the jury's outcome, their verdict, no matter what it is?
sentences.zh: 会。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 你已经排除了。

sentences.en: And have you ruled out a pardon for your son?
sentences.zh: 你会赦免你的儿子吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们不会。

sentences.en: You have.
sentences.zh: 第二个问题，如果总统的儿子被定罪，总统会赦免或减刑吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to pardon your son?
sentences.zh: 我已经回答过这个问题了。

sentences.en: And he tells us no.
sentences.zh: 有人问我不要……

sentences.en: Second one, would the president pardon or commute his son if he's convicted?
sentences.zh: 他的新闻秘书卡琳·让-皮埃尔再次说了同样的话，而且不可能。

sentences.en: So I've answered this question before.
sentences.zh: 我们已经被问过多次这个问题了。

sentences.en: It was asked of me not to...
sentences.zh: 我们的回答不变，那就是不会。

sentences.en: And his press secretary, Corrine Jean-Pierre, says it again and it can't be.
sentences.zh: 那个问题已经回答过了。

sentences.en: We've been asked that question multiple times.
sentences.zh: 我们的回答仍然一样。

sentences.en: Our answer stands, which is no.
sentences.zh: 不，他不会干预。

sentences.en: That question's been answered.
sentences.zh: 仍然是不会。

sentences.en: Our answer's still the same.
sentences.zh: 答案会是不会。

sentences.en: No, he will not intervene.
sentences.zh: 答案是不会。

sentences.en: It's still a no.
sentences.zh: 我没什么可补充的了。

sentences.en: It will be a no.
sentences.zh: 他会赦免他的儿子吗？

sentences.en: It is a no.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: And I don't have anything else to add.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Will he pardon his son?
sentences.zh: 我们应该说，他们没有留下任何回旋余地。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 他们没有说，嗯，他正在考虑，我们会回复你。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 他们断然说他不会这样做，他不会这样做是因为这背叛了他所陈述的价值观，以及他对系统应该如何运作，以及政治在司法系统中应该或不应该扮演的角色所持的期望。

sentences.en: And they don't leave, we should say, any wiggle room whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They don't say, well, he's thinking about it and we'll get back to you.
sentences.zh: 事实上，拜登总统在某一时刻甚至说他接受他儿子被定罪的第一次审判的结果，并且他尊重司法程序，

sentences.en: They emphatically say he's not going to do this and he's not going to do this because it betrays his stated values and his expectations about how the system should work and the role that politics should or shouldn't play in the justice system.
sentences.zh: 这是一种向全世界发出信号的方式，特别是与唐纳德·特朗普形成对比，表明他相信这个系统。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 他自己不会介入。

sentences.en: In fact, President Biden at one point even says that he accepts the outcome of the first trial in which his son is convicted and he respects the judicial process,
sentences.zh: 他不会为了自己的家庭而颠覆在那里所做的事情。

sentences.en: which is a way of signaling to the world at large and specifically in contrast to Donald Trump that he believes in the system.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这并不是故事的终点。

sentences.en: He will not get involved himself.
sentences.zh: 这就是我通常会问你具体是什么发生了变化的部分，但我认为我们可以直觉到，发生的一个重大变化是唐纳德·特朗普赢得了总统职位。

sentences.en: He will not upend what has been done there on behalf of his own family.
sentences.zh: 这最终是否似乎让天平从断然拒绝和“我不会玷污系统”的原则立场，转向了“我要赦免我的儿子”？

sentences.en: But obviously, that's not the end of the story.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为显然在六月他开始那样说和今天十二月他给予赦免之间，唯一改变的就是选举。

sentences.en: And this is the part where I would normally ask you what changed specifically, but I think we can intuit that a big thing that changed was that Donald Trump won the presidency.
sentences.zh: 你可以从几个不同的角度来看待它。

sentences.en: Is that ultimately what seems to tip the scales here from the emphatic nose and the principled position of I will not muddy the system to I'm going to pardon my son?
sentences.zh: 你可以认为他在夏天并不诚实，实际上他确实在考虑这件事，但不想在选举前说出来，因为这会在政治上造成损害。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think obviously the only thing that's changed between June when he begins saying that and today, December, when he gives this pardon is the election.
sentences.zh: 只有在选举后他才承认，事实上，他要为他的儿子使用这种非凡的权力，或者，这可能是一个“和/或”的情况，

sentences.en: And you can look at it a couple of different ways.
sentences.zh: 你也可以认为这是意识到特朗普领导下的司法部的现实，这位新总统承诺报复，特别是针对亨特·拜登。

sentences.en: You can look at it in the way of him not being honest in the summer that he really was, in fact,
sentences.zh: 一位即将离任的总统心想，我不会让那种事发生。

sentences.en: considering this but didn't want to say before an election because it would be politically damaging.
sentences.zh: 我不仅要赦免他的税务和枪支指控，我还要保护他免受下一个人的伤害，那个人非常清楚地表明他将利用联邦调查局进行报复。

sentences.en: And only after the election does he admit that, in fact, he is going to use this extraordinary power for his son or, and this may be an and or,
sentences.zh: 他为什么会这么想？

sentences.en: you can also look at it as waking up to the reality of a Trump-run Justice Department in which this new president is promising retribution and specifically to go after Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他只需要看看特朗普任命了谁来管理国家的执法机构就知道了。

sentences.en: And a president who's on the way out thinking, I'm not going to let that happen.
sentences.zh: 帕姆·邦迪，前佛罗里达州总检察长，他将提名她为司法部长。

sentences.en: I'm not only going to pardon him for this tax and gun charges, I'm going to protect him from the next guy who's making very clear he's going to use the FBI for retribution.
sentences.zh: 而卡什·帕特尔，他的一名前助手，如果得到参议院确认，将成为联邦调查局局长。

sentences.en: And why would he think that?
sentences.zh: 他们两人都被认为是尖锐的党派战士，他们认同特朗普的阴谋论、他的选举谎言，以及他对政敌进行报复的嗜好。

sentences.en: Well, he has only to look at who Trump has been naming to run the nation's law enforcement agencies.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看出拜登在赦免令中的措辞是在保护他的儿子免受特朗普的伤害。

sentences.en: Pam Bondi, a former Florida attorney general, he will nominate for attorney general.
sentences.zh: 赦免令只是说——

sentences.en: And Kash Patel, a former aide to him, will be, if confirmed by the Senate, the FBI director.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谈谈那个。

sentences.en: Both of them are known as sharply partisan warriors who have subscribed to Trump's conspiracy theories, his election lies, and his taste for retribution against his enemies.
sentences.zh: 谈谈赦免令的表达方式、它涵盖的范围，以及它揭示了什么。

sentences.en: And so you can tell Biden is protecting his son from Trump by the way he words it in the pardon.
sentences.zh: 这份赦免令相当非凡，因为它不仅仅说我们免除亨特·拜登已被判有罪的定罪，

sentences.en: The pardon just said—
sentences.zh: 它还涵盖了可能涉及的任何其他指控。

sentences.en: Well, talk about that.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是试图为他提供一个全方位的保护伞。

sentences.en: Talk about the way the pardon is articulated, the ground it covers, and what that reveals.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是关于过去的定罪，也是关于未来的潜在指控。

sentences.en: The pardon is rather extraordinary because it doesn't just say that we absolve Hunter Biden of the convictions for which he has already been found,
sentences.zh: 这确实是总统权力的极端运用。

sentences.en: but we absolve him of any crimes he may have committed on any kind of topic for 10 years, starting in 2014 until 2024.
sentences.zh: 但他赦免了他在2014年至2024年这十年间可能犯下的任何类型的罪行。

sentences.en: We haven't seen a pardon.
sentences.zh: 我们从未见过这样的特赦。

sentences.en: We haven't seen a pardon like that, as sweeping as that, in decades, probably not since Watergate.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，我们从未见过如此全面、如此彻底的特赦，恐怕自水门事件以来就没出现过。

sentences.en: And what it says is, in effect, that no matter what Trump and his Republican allies may come up with about Hunter, they can't prosecute him for that.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这意味着无论特朗普及其共和党盟友对亨特提出什么指控，他们都无法因此起诉他。

sentences.en: And it's really a way of insulating Hunter, not just from the convictions he's already facing,
sentences.zh: 这确实是一种保护亨特的方式，不仅是为了让他免受已经面临的定罪，

sentences.en: but from any future investigation by and what Biden would believe to be a politicized Trump administration justice department.
sentences.zh: 也是为了让他免受未来拜登所认为的政治化特朗普政府司法部的任何调查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's like a flashing red light that says, don't even bother to investigate Hunter Biden because this pardon means that the places you would look and the charges you might bring,
sentences.zh: 这就像一个闪烁的红灯，警告说：别费心去调查亨特·拜登了，因为这项特赦意味着你原本会调查的地方和可能提出的指控，

sentences.en: I have just made it impossible for you to charge him for anything during that period.
sentences.zh: 我已经让你无法在这一时期内对他进行任何指控了。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: It's a 10-year get-out-of-jail-free card, right?
sentences.zh: 这相当于一张十年的“免罪金牌”，对吧？

sentences.en: Anything he might have done wrong,
sentences.zh: 他可能做错的任何事情，

sentences.en: including all the different suspicious things that Republicans think that they have been looking into about trading influence with businesses and so forth,
sentences.zh: 包括共和党人认为他们一直在调查的关于商业利益输送等各种可疑行为，

sentences.en: none of that is prosecutable anymore.
sentences.zh: 现在都无法再进行起诉了。

sentences.en: Well, what, if anything, does Biden say about his reasoning for why he issued such a sweeping pardon?
sentences.zh: 那么，拜登本人对于为何发布如此全面的特赦有什么解释吗？

sentences.en: On the one hand, he says, understandably, that this is the act of a father, right?
sentences.zh: 一方面，他可以理解地表示，这是一位父亲的行为，对吧？

sentences.en: He says, I hope Americans will understand why a father and a president would come to this decision.
sentences.zh: 他说，我希望美国人能理解为什么一位父亲兼总统会做出这个决定。

sentences.en: Those were his words.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的原话。

sentences.en: And he's referring to the struggles that his son has had with addiction over the years and that, in his view,
sentences.zh: 他指的是他儿子多年来与毒瘾的斗争，在他看来，

sentences.en: drug and alcohol addiction is really behind the crimes for which he was convicted.
sentences.zh: 毒品和酒精成瘾才是他被定罪的罪行背后的真正原因。

sentences.en: That lying on the firearms form and the tax evasion were all a symptom of this larger struggle that he has now, in theory, overcome.
sentences.zh: 在枪支表格上撒谎和逃税，都是他这场更大斗争的症状，而理论上他现在已经克服了这些。

sentences.en: If he had left at that, that might be one thing I think a lot of people would have understood that, even if they didn't think it was the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 如果他只说到这里，我想很多人即使不认为这是正确的做法，也能理解他的初衷。

sentences.en: But instead, he adds to that a very blistering attack on the prosecution against his son.
sentences.zh: 但相反，他还对针对他儿子的起诉进行了猛烈的抨击。

sentences.en: He says that his son would never have been wrought for felony charges if it hadn't been for his last name, that he's being singled out.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果不是因为他的姓氏，他的儿子绝不会被控重罪，他是在被针对。

sentences.en: He says, in fact, in the statement he puts out with the pardon,
sentences.zh: 事实上，他在随特赦令发布的声明中说，

sentences.en: that no reasonable person who looks at the facts of Hunter's cases can reach any other conclusion that Hunter was singled out only because he is my son.
sentences.zh: 任何理性的人在审视亨特案件的事实后，都无法得出除“亨特仅仅因为是我的儿子才被针对”之外的任何结论。

sentences.en: And this is not, to your earlier point, a blistering attack just on partisan Republican congressional investigations into his son.
sentences.zh: 而且，正如你之前提到的，这不仅仅是对共和党国会针对他儿子的党派调查的猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: This is a pretty blistering attack really on his own Department of Justice and the lawyers and prosecutors within it who brought cases against his son.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是对他自己的司法部，以及其中那些对他儿子提起诉讼的律师和检察官的严厉抨击。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He doesn't explicitly say the Justice Department is bad the same way Trump does all the time.
sentences.zh: 他并没有像特朗普那样总是明确地说司法部很糟糕。

sentences.en: But he does say that raw politics, that's his phrase, raw politics has infected this process and it led to a miscarriage of justice.
sentences.zh: 但他确实说“原始政治”——这是他的原话——已经侵蚀了这个过程，并导致了司法不公。

sentences.en: His words.
sentences.zh: 这是他的原话。

sentences.en: How has it infected it, he doesn't exactly say.
sentences.zh: 他并没有确切说明它是如何被侵蚀的。

sentences.en: But obviously, who would it affect would be his own Justice Department, that he's saying that his own Justice Department, through the special counsel,
sentences.zh: 但显而易见，受影响的将是他自己的司法部，他是在说他自己的司法部通过特别检察官，

sentences.en: which does have some insulation from politics in theory,
sentences.zh: 虽然理论上在一定程度上不受政治影响，

sentences.en: has in fact been influenced by the Republicans who have been out there banging the drums about Hunter Biden and been tougher on his son, in effect, because of that.
sentences.zh: 但实际上受到了那些一直在大肆炒作亨特·拜登问题的共和党人的影响，并因此对他儿子采取了更严厉的手段。

sentences.en: And what really struck me in reading this statement was how much it sounded like another president, Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 在阅读这份声明时，真正让我震惊的是，它听起来多么像另一位总统——唐纳德·特朗普，

sentences.en: who's been saying a lot of the same things about a broken Justice Department infected by politics.
sentences.zh: 他一直在说很多关于司法部被政治侵蚀、已经崩溃的类似言论。

sentences.en: And now, suddenly, that gives a whole new complexion to this debate about the role of justice in American society.
sentences.zh: 现在，这突然为关于司法在社会中作用的辩论增添了全新的色彩。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题，我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Peter, in reflecting on what you said just before the break,
sentences.zh: 彼得，回顾你刚才在休息前说的话，

sentences.en: it feels like what Biden is asking the country to do with this pardon is to accept the idea that the justice system made serious mistakes
sentences.zh: 感觉拜登通过这次特赦要求全国接受的观点是：司法系统犯了严重错误，

sentences.en: and was politicized in this one case involving its pursuit of his son, but that we shouldn't apply that same thinking to other cases that this Justice Department has taken up,
sentences.zh: 并且在涉及他儿子的这个案件中被政治化了，但我们不应该将同样的逻辑应用到司法部处理的其他案件中，

sentences.en: including, and perhaps above all, those brought against Trump.
sentences.zh: 包括，或许最重要的是，那些针对特朗普的案件。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And that's the kind of situational judgment that is, of course,
sentences.zh: 这种情境化的判断当然是有问题的，

sentences.en: problematic because either the justice system is something you have faith in or it's a corrupted department at this point.
sentences.zh: 因为要么你对司法系统有信心，要么它现在就是一个腐败的部门。

sentences.en: And Trump and his allies very quickly seized on this pardon to say, see, we were right.
sentences.zh: 特朗普及其盟友很快抓住了这次特赦，声称：看，我们说得对。

sentences.en: Even Biden now says that the Justice Department can be infected by politics, can be used as a weapon against somebody, and it's been used against our guy, Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 连拜登现在都说司法部会被政治侵蚀，可以被当作攻击某人的武器，而且它已经被用来对付我们的人——唐纳德·特朗普，

sentences.en: in these other cases, which are far more serious, by the way, than anything Hunter Biden's been accused of.
sentences.zh: 在其他那些案件中，顺便说一句，那些案件比亨特·拜登被指控的任何事情都要严重得多。

sentences.en: But that distinction gets lost, right?
sentences.zh: 但这种区别被忽略了，对吧？

sentences.en: It ends up becoming a false equivalence, but one that's very useful politically.
sentences.zh: 这最终变成了一种错误的等同，但这种等同在政治上非常有用。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's the risk that Biden, I think, quite consciously understood he was taking here, that he was going to be, to some degree, undermining people's faith in the system.
sentences.zh: 我认为拜登相当清醒地意识到他正在承担这个风险，即他在某种程度上会削弱人们对系统的信心。

sentences.en: But if you're Biden, there is kind of a reality, right, Peter,
sentences.zh: 但如果你是拜登，彼得，这确实存在一种现实，对吧？

sentences.en: that Trump and his appointees and his whole approach to the Justice Department does present a unique threat to Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 特朗普及其任命的人员以及他对待司法部的整体方式，确实对亨特·拜登构成了独特的威胁。

sentences.en: And that I don't think many people doubt that Trump wanted to go after Hunter Biden, said so, and if we've learned anything about Trump,
sentences.zh: 我不认为很多人会怀疑特朗普想要对付亨特·拜登，他自己也这么说过，如果我们从特朗普身上学到了什么，

sentences.en: it's to believe him when he says he's going to do something.
sentences.zh: 那就是当他说他要做某事时，要相信他。

sentences.en: So if you're Biden and you want to protect your son, is there a reality that you have to begin to operate on Trump's terms?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是拜登，想要保护你的儿子，是否有一种现实是你必须开始按照特朗普的规则行事？

sentences.en: And that's really what happened here.
sentences.zh: 这确实就是这里发生的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's a good way of putting it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这样说很贴切。

sentences.en: He is operating in some ways on Trump's terMs.
sentences.zh: 他在某些方面确实是在按照特朗普的规则行事。

sentences.en: He doesn't actually say that in the statement, which is interesting, right?
sentences.zh: 他在声明中并没有明确说出来，这很有趣，对吧？

sentences.en: He talks about the current prosecutions that his son has faced being unfair and selective.
sentences.zh: 他谈到他儿子目前面临的起诉是不公平和选择性的。

sentences.en: He doesn't say the other part, which you just rightly focused on, which is that he is guarding against politicization of the Justice Department by his successor, right?
sentences.zh: 他没有说出你刚才准确指出的另一部分，即他是在防范继任者对司法部的政治化，对吧？

sentences.en: He could have framed it that way, but he didn't.
sentences.zh: 他本可以那样表述，但他没有。

sentences.en: But the net effect of what he did by making it a 10-year sweeping pardon for any and everything that his son might have done does have that effect.
sentences.zh: 但通过发布一项为期十年、涵盖他儿子可能做过的任何事情的全面特赦，其最终效果确实达到了这一点。

sentences.en: And it does tell you what was probably going through his mind when he decided to issue the pardon.
sentences.zh: 这确实告诉你，当他决定发布特赦时，他心里可能在想什么。

sentences.en: And that makes me wonder, do you think that President Biden—and this is a difficult question,
sentences.zh: 这让我不禁想问，你认为拜登总统——这是一个难题，

sentences.en: I'll just preface it by saying that—would have issued this pardon if Trump had lost and his vice president, Kamala Harris, had won the election?
sentences.zh: 我先说明一下——如果特朗普输了，而他的副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯赢得了选举，他还会发布这项特赦吗？

sentences.en: Because that would have meant there was a much lower level of threat to Hunter Biden under Kamala Harris Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 因为那意味着在卡玛拉·哈里斯的司法部下，亨特·拜登面临的威胁程度要低得多。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's an excellent question and one that we didn't get an answer to when we asked the White House.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常好的问题，我们在询问白宫时没有得到答案。

sentences.en: But you're right to ask it because it does make you wonder how much of this is about saving him from the possible prison terms he might have under the guilty verdict he already has versus looking ahead at what's in store.
sentences.zh: 但你提出这个问题是对的，因为它确实让人怀疑，这在多大程度上是为了让他免受现有有罪判决可能带来的刑期，还是在展望未来可能发生的事情。

sentences.en: And it is possible that had the Democrats won, whether it had been him when he was running or Harris when she was running, that he wouldn't have felt compelled to do this.
sentences.zh: 如果民主党获胜，无论是他自己参选还是哈里斯参选，他可能都不会感到有必要这样做。

sentences.en: But we won't know.
sentences.zh: 但我们不得而知。

sentences.en: And he hasn't said.
sentences.zh: 而且他也没有说。

sentences.en: Peter, you mentioned how Trump and his Republican allies are responding to this pardon.
sentences.zh: 彼得，你提到了特朗普及其共和党盟友对这次特赦的反应。

sentences.en: But I'm curious about how Democratic elected officials and operatives are feeling about this decision because you could see a world where some of them might welcome it.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇民主党民选官员和工作人员对这个决定有何感想，因为你可以预见，有些人可能会欢迎它。

sentences.en: They might cheer it and say, finally, President Biden and Democrats, you are living in the kind of hand-to-hand combat world of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会欢呼并说：终于，拜登总统和民主党人，你们开始进入唐纳德·特朗普那种肉搏战的世界了。

sentences.en: You're meeting him where he is, to use the phrase we just did a couple of minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 你们正在用我们刚才提到的那个词，在那个层面上与他交锋。

sentences.en: You're meeting him on his terMs.
sentences.zh: 你们正在按照他的规则与他交锋。

sentences.en: You could just as easily, however, see Democrats say, President Biden, you just stooped to Trump's level.
sentences.zh: 然而，你同样可以很容易地看到民主党人说：拜登总统，你刚刚堕落到了特朗普的水平。

sentences.en: You betrayed what you said you stood for.
sentences.zh: 你背叛了你所声称的立场。

sentences.en: And you've tarnished our entire political brand in the process all to protect your son.
sentences.zh: 而且在此过程中，你为了保护儿子，玷污了我们整个政治品牌。

sentences.en: Well, and Democrats being Democrats, they're saying both those things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，民主党人毕竟是民主党人，他们两种声音都有。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: There are a number of Democrats out there who are saying, look, you know, the president is right.
sentences.zh: 有很多民主党人说，看，总统是对的。

sentences.en: His son was targeted because he was his son.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子是因为是他的儿子才被针对的。

sentences.en: He would have gotten such harsh treatment had his name been Hunter Smith instead of Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 如果他叫亨特·史密斯而不是亨特·拜登，他绝不会受到如此严厉的对待。

sentences.en: You hear that most prominently, for instance, from Eric Holder, former attorney general under President Obama.
sentences.zh: 你最常听到这种说法，例如来自奥巴马总统时期的前司法部长埃里克·霍尔德。

sentences.en: And there's some truth to that, according to experts we have interviewed in the past, saying that, you know,
sentences.zh: 根据我们过去采访过的专家，这种说法确实有一定道理，他们说，

sentences.en: that a lot of these cases like Hunter Biden's wouldn't have gone as far as his did.
sentences.zh: 很多像亨特·拜登这样的案件，本来不会像他的案件那样深入发展。

sentences.en: On the other hand, it's also worth pointing out that when Biden says his son is being prosecuted for his last name,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，也值得指出的是，当拜登说他儿子是因为姓氏而被起诉时，

sentences.en: he didn't have any complaints when his son was profiting in business using his last name.
sentences.zh: 当他儿子利用姓氏在商业中获利时，他可没有任何抱怨。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Did all the companies give him millions of dollars because his name was Hunter Biden, not Hunter Smith?
sentences.zh: 难道所有的公司给他数百万美元不是因为他叫亨特·拜登，而不是亨特·史密斯吗？

sentences.en: So, you know, being the son of a president has its benefits and its drawbacks.
sentences.zh: 所以，作为总统的儿子既有好处也有坏处。

sentences.en: And in this case, obviously, you can argue that's had both of those things.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，显然你可以说两者兼而有之。

sentences.en: But there are other Democrats, as you rightly point out, who are upset about this, who say, no, this is not a good thing.
sentences.zh: 但正如你正确指出的那样，还有其他民主党人对此感到不满，他们说，不，这不是一件好事。

sentences.en: While it's totally understandable what a father might want to do, it undercuts the independence of the justice system.
sentences.zh: 虽然作为父亲想要做什么完全可以理解，但这削弱了司法系统的独立性。

sentences.en: And it undercuts the debate against Trump's corruption of it.
sentences.zh: 而且它削弱了反对特朗普腐败行为的辩论基础。

sentences.en: I talked to Senator Michael Bennett, a Democrat from Colorado, who says, totally understands what a father must feel like in this, he said.
sentences.zh: 我采访了科罗拉多州的民主党参议员迈克尔·本内特，他说，完全理解作为父亲在这种情况下会有什么感受。

sentences.en: But it's, and he quotes here, another instance of putting his personal interests ahead of his responsibility to the country.
sentences.zh: 但他引用的话说，这是“将个人利益置于对国家的责任之上的又一个例子”。

sentences.en: And when Senator Bennett says another instance, is he referring to the first instance being Biden staying in the race for president too long?
sentences.zh: 当本内特参议员说“又一个例子”时，他指的是第一个例子是拜登在总统竞选中停留时间过长吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: This pardon comes at a moment when Democrats are already pretty upset at Biden over the election result, blaming him more than Kamala Harris for losing to Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 这次特赦发生的时刻，民主党人本已对拜登在选举结果上的表现感到非常不满，比起卡玛拉·哈里斯，他们更多地将输给唐纳德·特朗普的责任归咎于他，

sentences.en: believing that he put the Democrats in this position because he decided to run for reelection,
sentences.zh: 认为他因为决定竞选连任而使民主党陷入了这种境地，

sentences.en: even though everyone knew he was going to be 86 by the end of a second term and therefore would be problematic.
sentences.zh: 尽管每个人都知道他到第二个任期结束时将是86岁，因此会有问题。

sentences.en: And again, that he himself knew that his own approval ratings were pretty low and didn't give the next generation a chance in a primary fashion to come up with a candidate,
sentences.zh: 而且再次强调，他自己也知道他的支持率相当低，却没有在初选中给下一代机会去推出一位候选人，

sentences.en: whether it be Kamala Harris or somebody else, who would be tested and a proven commodity by the time it came to a general election against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 无论是卡玛拉·哈里斯还是其他人，这样的人在与唐纳德·特朗普进行大选时，会是经过考验且证明过能力的。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of consternation about President Biden among Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以民主党内部对拜登总统有很多焦虑。

sentences.en: Peter, it strikes me that the decision Biden made to stay in the presidential race as long as he did, what Michael Bennett just referred to,
sentences.zh: 彼得，我注意到拜登决定在总统竞选中停留那么久——也就是迈克尔·本内特刚才提到的——

sentences.en: and this decision to pardon his son Hunter, that they have some similarities.
sentences.zh: 以及这次赦免他儿子亨特的决定，它们有一些相似之处。

sentences.en: Because in both cases, it feels to me anyway, Biden had to choose between a personal desire and a pretty big principle.
sentences.zh: 因为在我看来，在这两种情况下，拜登都必须在个人愿望和一个相当大的原则之间做出选择。

sentences.en: The principle in the campaign decision was, should I step down for the good of my party and the good of my country?
sentences.zh: 竞选决定中的原则是：我应该为了党和国家的利益而退出吗？

sentences.en: In the decision around his son, it was, do I choose my son or do I choose the integrity of the system that I have defended for decades?
sentences.zh: 在关于他儿子的决定中，原则是：我选择我的儿子，还是选择我几十年来一直捍卫的系统完整性？

sentences.en: Yeah, no, this is a Shakespearean quality to this story, right, in both those instances.
sentences.zh: 是的，在这两个例子中，这个故事确实有一种莎士比亚式的特质，对吧？

sentences.en: Look, presidents, by definition, are people with a certain degree of hubris.
sentences.zh: 看，总统从定义上讲，都是具有一定程度傲慢的人。

sentences.en: They believe inevitably in their own greatness.
sentences.zh: 他们不可避免地相信自己的伟大。

sentences.en: Otherwise, how can you look in the mirror and say, I am the person who should be president of this country more than any of the other 330 million people who live here?
sentences.zh: 否则，你怎么能看着镜子说，我就是那个比这里居住的其他3.3亿人更应该担任这个国家总统的人？

sentences.en: But it's also a very human story.
sentences.zh: 但这同时也是一个非常人性化的故事。

sentences.en: It is a story of a president who had to make a decision between principle on the one hand and defending a system, even if you thought it had mishandled the situation,
sentences.zh: 这是一个总统的故事，他必须在原则与捍卫系统（即使他认为该系统处理不当）之间，以及允许儿子入狱之间做出决定。

sentences.en: and allowing your son to go to prison.
sentences.zh: 而且这里有一种负罪感，对吧？

sentences.en: And there's a sense of guilt there, right?
sentences.zh: 再次强调，这是莎士比亚式的。

sentences.en: Again, this is Shakespearean.
sentences.zh: 他为亨特成为目标感到内疚。

sentences.en: He feels guilty that Hunter has been targeted.
sentences.zh: 他为过去几年他儿子身上发生的一切感到内疚。

sentences.en: He feels guilty about all that has happened to his son over these last few years.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是因为亨特的成瘾和导致定罪的错误，他的生活被彻底颠覆了，

sentences.en: That it isn't just Hunter's fault because of his addiction and because of the mistakes that led to convictions, that his life has been torn upside down,
sentences.zh: 他因为他——总统——而在公共场合受到折磨，而他只有通过发布这项特赦才能纠正这一切。

sentences.en: that he's been tortured in a public setting because of him, the president, and that he can make it right only by issuing this pardon.
sentences.zh: 彼得，我想以特赦本身的问题作为结束，

sentences.en: Peter, I just want to end on the very question of pardons,
sentences.zh: 我感觉我总是回到一种困惑感，即为什么在我们的民主制度中，任何人会被赋予这种单一的权力。

sentences.en: and I feel like I always return to a feeling of bewilderment that anyone has been endowed in our democratic system with this singular power.
sentences.zh: 当特朗普赦免贾里德·库什纳的父亲时，我有这种感觉。

sentences.en: I had that feeling when Trump was pardoning Jared Kushner's father.
sentences.zh: 当比尔·克林顿赦免他的亲戚时，我有这个问题。

sentences.en: I had that question when Bill Clinton was pardoning a relative of his.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我诚实地说，当乔·拜登赦免他的儿子时，我也有这个问题。

sentences.en: Because if I'm being honest, I have this question now when Joe Biden is pardoning his son.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一种君王般的权力，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, it is a kingly kind of power, right?
sentences.zh: 制宪者在将此写入宪法时就知道了这一点。

sentences.en: And the founders knew that when they wrote that into the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 但他们也将其视为对可能出错的系统的一种制衡，对吧？

sentences.en: But they also viewed it as a check on a system that could go awry, right?
sentences.zh: 他们并不一定预见到这会成为对付总统自己家人的系统出错时的制衡。

sentences.en: And they didn't necessarily envision it being a check on a system going awry against the president's own family.
sentences.zh: 他们将其视为一种纠正系统错误的方式，针对的是每天受到司法系统影响、在某些情况下受到不公平对待的普通美国人。

sentences.en: What they saw it as was a way to correct errors in the system against ordinary Americans who are every day subjected to the justice system and in some cases unfairly treated.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么司法部内有一个特赦办公室，负责向总统发送建议，并有一个试图纠正系统错误的过程。

sentences.en: And that's why there is a pardon office in the Justice Department that sends recommendations to the president, that has a process that tries, in fact,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么司法部内有一个特赦办公室，负责向总统发送建议，并有一个试图纠正系统错误的过程。

sentences.en: to correct the wrongs of the system.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么司法部内有一个特赦办公室，负责向总统发送建议，并有一个试图纠正系统错误的过程。

sentences.en: Because, of course, the system gets things wrong.
sentences.zh: 因为系统当然会出错。

sentences.en: Every system does at some point or another.
sentences.zh: 任何系统在某个时候都会出错。

sentences.en: But what happened here with Biden's pardon, and a lot of Trump's pardons for that matter, too, is that it didn't go through any process.
sentences.zh: 但拜登这次的赦免，以及特朗普的许多赦免，问题在于它们没有经过任何程序。

sentences.en: And that raises a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 这引发了许多疑问。

sentences.en: What is justice in America?
sentences.zh: 美国的正义是什么？

sentences.en: Who says it's fair and not tainted?
sentences.zh: 谁能说它是公平且未受玷污的？

sentences.en: How do you take politics out of it?
sentences.zh: 你如何将政治从中剥离出来？

sentences.en: And we seem to be putting more politics into it with each passing day.
sentences.zh: 而我们似乎每天都在往其中注入更多的政治因素。

sentences.en: Well, Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，彼得，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: In a letter on Monday, the outgoing Senate Majority Leader, Democrat Chuck Schumer,
sentences.zh: 周一，即将离任的参议院多数党领袖、民主党人查克·舒默在一封信中，

sentences.en: urged his Republican colleagues to push for traditional confirmation hearings and FBI-led background checks for Donald Trump's cabinet picks.
sentences.zh: 敦促他的共和党同僚推动对唐纳德·特朗普的内阁人选进行传统的确认听证会和联邦调查局主导的背景调查。

sentences.en: The letter comes as Trump and those around him signal an eagerness to fill his cabinet through recess appointments that bypass Senate votes and without FBI background checks that might uncover embarrassing facts about his choices.
sentences.zh: 这封信发出的背景是，特朗普及其身边的人表现出急于通过休会任命来填补内阁空缺，从而绕过参议院投票，并免除可能揭露其人选尴尬事实的联邦调查局背景调查。

sentences.en: And the CEO of the CEO of the CEO of the CEO of Intel has stepped down in the latest sign of the company's troubles.
sentences.zh: 英特尔的首席执行官已经辞职，这是该公司陷入困境的最新迹象。

sentences.en: On Monday's show, we used Intel as a case study of why President Biden's plans to revive U.S.
sentences.zh: 在周一的节目中，我们以英特尔为例，分析了为什么拜登总统振兴美国

sentences.en: manufacturing will be so challenging.
sentences.zh: 制造业的计划将面临如此巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: The Biden administration hopes to invest billions of dollars into Intel to promote domestic manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府希望向英特尔投资数十亿美元，以促进国内制造业发展。

sentences.en: But Intel has failed to keep up with its rivals and has increasingly lost the confidence of tech companies that rely on advanced computer chips.
sentences.zh: 但英特尔未能跟上竞争对手的步伐，并日益失去依赖先进计算机芯片的科技公司的信任。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Carlos Prieto, Jessica Chung, and Luke Vanderplugge, with help from Eric Krupke.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卡洛斯·普列托、杰西卡·钟和卢克·范德普鲁格制作，埃里克·克鲁普克提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Michael Benoit, with help from Paige Cowan.
sentences.zh: 节目由迈克尔·贝努瓦剪辑，佩奇·考恩提供了协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽昂·洛萨诺的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·莫克斯利负责工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderland的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》到此结束。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Babara.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴拉。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否喝得烂醉才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
